caveats: Identity boundary: Legal or officially reported worker identity only to the extent established by cited sources; do not merge by name or image similarity.
Employment aliases may be stolen, borrowed, or synthetic identities; do not imply that the apparent alias owner is the DPRK worker.
Same-source depth from the already-admitted MSMT/2025/2 report; this fragment is not independent corroboration and not an independent source family.
Victim and employer names, accounts, payments, selectors, contacts, identity documents, birth dates, and precise addresses are excluded.
Persona names shown here are labels reported by the cited publisher. They are not asserted to be anyone's legal name, and unrelated real people who share a name are not implicated.

'Eugene Ong' and 'Eujin Ong' are common real names in Singapore and Malaysia. MSMT reports them as aliases used by Choe Kum Song as of June 2024 and does not identify any real person; no real Eugene Ong should be inferred to be this worker.
Accounts and handles are historical observations reported by the cited sources. Present control of any account is not asserted, and a persona name is not asserted to be anyone's legal identity.
